title: Oscar and the Winter
author: Mara Brightwater
blurb: Coral Sandoval, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the harvest moon rises.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
